item.title: Test + Tren + Dbol
item.description: I don’t like Dbol for it’s bloat and estrogen modulation, but you got an AI on hand so just take as needed when you feel gyno, prob could even do a half EOD and be ok. The clinical use to crush aromatase is a full 1mg a day for example. Otherwise stack is fine, people fearmonger about tren, but it’s no more “toxic” than any other injectable really, the sides that make people bail are the insomnia and “rage” which is the mental stimulation which you may or may not be able to handle.
